text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Command the Israelites, and say to them: My offering, the food for my offerings by fire, my pleasing odor, you shall take care to offer to me at its appointed time.
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民说：你们应在规定的时期内，准时将献给我的供物──我的食品，焚化为中悦我的馨香火祭献给我。

text_en: And you shall say to them, This is the offering by fire that you shall offer to the Lord : two male lambs a year old without blemish, daily, as a regular offering.
text_cn: 你对他们说：这是你们应献给上主的火祭：每天应献两只一岁无瑕的公羔羊，做日常的全燔祭：

text_en: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
text_cn: 早上献一只，傍晚献一只；

text_en: also one-tenth of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with one-fourth of a hin of beaten oil.
text_cn: 还应献十分之一‘厄法’细面，调上四分之一‘辛’榨得的油，作为素祭。

text_en: It is a regular burnt offering, ordained at Mount Sinai for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 这是在西乃山上规定应行的日常全燔祭，作为献与上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: Its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the sanctuary you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord .
text_cn: 此外，为每只公羔羊，应奠上四分之一‘辛’的酒：这是在圣所内向上主献的醇酒祭。

text_en: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight with a grain offering and a drink offering like the one in the morning; you shall offer it as an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 傍晚应献另一只公羔羊、素祭和奠祭，如早晨所献的一样，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: On the sabbath day: two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering—
text_cn: 安息日，应献两只一岁无瑕的公羔羊，十分之二‘厄法’油调的细面，当作素祭；还有同献的奠祭。

text_en: this is the burnt offering for every sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
text_cn: 这是每安息日，除日常的全燔祭和奠祭外，应献的安息日全燔祭。

text_en: At the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord : two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;
text_cn: 每月初一，应给上主献一全燔祭：即公牛犊二头，公绵羊一只，一岁无瑕的公羔羊七只。

text_en: also three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two-tenths of choice flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
text_cn: 为每头公牛犊同献的素祭，是十分之三‘厄法’油调的细面；为每一只公绵羊同献的素祭，是十分之二‘厄法’油调的细面；

text_en: and one-tenth of choice flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for every lamb—a burnt offering of pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 为每只公羔羊同献的素祭，是十分之一‘厄法’油调的细面：这是馨香的全燔祭，是献给天主的火祭。

text_en: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
text_cn: 此外尚有奠祭：为每头公牛犊奠半‘辛’酒，为每只公绵羊奠三分之一‘辛’，为每只公羔羊奠四分一‘辛’：这是一年内，每月初一应献的全燔祭。

text_en: And there shall be one male goat for a sin offering to the Lord ; it shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
text_cn: 除日常的全燔祭和同献的奠祭外，还应献给上主一只公山羊作赎罪祭。

text_en: On the fourteenth day of the first month there shall be a passover offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 正月十四日是上主的逾越节，

text_en: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
text_cn: 这月十五日是庆日，七天之内应吃无酵饼。

text_en: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 第一日应召开圣会，一切劳工都不许做。

text_en: You shall offer an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the Lord : two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; see that they are without blemish.
text_cn: 应献给上主作火祭的全燔祭，是两头公牛犊，一只公绵羊，和七只一岁的公羔羊，全应是无瑕疵的。

text_en: Their grain offering shall be of choice flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah shall you offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;
text_cn: 至于同献的素祭，应是油调的细面：为每头公牛犊献十分之三‘厄法’，为每只公绵羊献十分之二‘厄法’；

text_en: one-tenth shall you offer for each of the seven lambs;
text_cn: 至于那七只公羔羊，为每只献十分之一‘厄法’。

text_en: also one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
text_cn: 此外，还应献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

text_en: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which belongs to the regular burnt offering.
text_cn: 除早晨应献的日常全燔祭外，还应奉献这些祭品。

text_en: In the same way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of an offering by fire, a pleasing odor to the Lord ; it shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
text_cn: 七天之久，每天都应奉献这样的祭品，给上主作为馨香火祭的食品；应献的日常全燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。

text_en: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 到第七日再召开圣会，一切劳工都不许做。

text_en: On the day of the first fruits, when you offer a grain offering of new grain to the Lord at your festival of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall not work at your occupations.
text_cn: 在初熟节，即七七节内，给上主献荐新的素祭时，应召开圣会，一切劳工都不许做。

text_en: You shall offer a burnt offering, a pleasing odor to the Lord : two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old.
text_cn: 你们应献给上主馨香的全燔祭，即二头公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只一岁的公羔羊；

text_en: Their grain offering shall be of choice flour mixed with oil, three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for one ram,
text_cn: 至于同献的素祭，是油调的细面：为每头公牛犊献十分之三‘厄法’，为每只公绵羊献十分之二‘厄法’；

text_en: one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
text_cn: 至于那七只公羔羊，为每只献十分之一‘厄法’。

text_en: with one male goat, to make atonement for you.
text_cn: 此外，还应献一只公山羊，为你们赎罪。

text_en: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, you shall offer them and their drink offering. They shall be without blemish.
text_cn: 除日常全燔祭和同献的素祭外，还应献这些无瑕疵的祭品和同献的奠祭。
